sourceInspection.method: Visual review of the locked V40 PDF page 1, printed step 2 green Pi4/Pi5 panel and its circled USB Mini Microphone detail, rendered privately; source pixels are not copied into authored output
sourceInspection.observation: The red arrow carries a flat USB-A plug horizontally into an opening of the rear-facing stacked USB block, wide face horizontal. The arrow tip lands on the upper opening of the stack.

selection.usbBlockRule: Of the two rear USB blocks of the adopted Pi5 artifact, the one with the larger board-local Y (nearest the GPIO header side).
selection.basis: The manual shows the plug entering the upper opening of a rear USB stack. The accepted graph interface PX-V40-IF-PI5-USB-PORT has an unresolved frame (Q-10), so which equivalent opening an owner uses is not source-determined and remains open.

plug.seatedDepthRule: Authored plug length is fully inside the port block; the body face is flush with the mouth plane.

limitations: Pi5 USB opening choice is a presentation choice among equivalent openings; Q-10 stays unresolved
USB port cavity is omitted from the Pi5 proxy; plug-in-port overlap is a declared omitted-cavity proxy overlap, not a fit or engagement result
Plug and port dimensions are authored presentation proxies; no USB electrical, mechanical retention or allocation claim
